categories.label: Necklaces & Chokers
categories.rule: Capture the necklace draped gracefully along natural collarbone curvature or on a sculpted plinth, preserving authentic foil backing, unblemished stones, and handcrafted enamel work.

categories.label: Earrings & Jhumkas
categories.rule: Position the earrings upright or suspended with a subtle shadow drop, keeping every prong, micro-pavé facet, and dangling pearl cluster in sharp focus.

categories.label: Bangles & Kadas
categories.rule: Show the kadas angled to display exterior meenakari carvings and bezel-set gemstones, maintaining the exact cylindrical gauge and antique gold patina.

categories.label: Rings & Maang Teeka
categories.rule: Frame in a sharp macro composition that captures the centre stone crown and delicate filigree chain without distorting ring band thickness or metal luster.

styles.label: Macro
styles.rule: Shot with a 100mm macro lens at f/8 with a razor-thin depth of field, highlighting microscopic metal engraving, stone facets, and authentic hand-set prongs.

styles.label: FlatLay
styles.rule: Overhead 90-degree top-down perspective on textured raw linen with organic accents, styled with soft daylight diffusion and subtle natural falloff.

styles.label: Studio
styles.rule: Classic commercial studio setup against a pristine neutral backdrop with balanced twin softboxes for edge-to-edge sharpness and zero colour cast.

styles.label: Shop Display
styles.rule: Staged on an illuminated luxury boutique glass plinth with warm velvet risers and architectural brass accents, creating an aspirational storefront atmosphere.

styles.label: Indian Bridal
styles.rule: Rich royal Indian bridal mood featuring crimson silk zardozi textiles, warm ambient temple glow, and dramatic ceremonial side-lighting.

styles.label: Modern Wear
styles.rule: Contemporary high-fashion editorial on a chic linen ensemble with clean architectural daylight, capturing effortless luxury for modern daily wear.

styles.label: Vintage Sepia
styles.rule: Muted sepia-toned archival treatment reminiscent of early 20th-century royal portraiture.

backgrounds.label: Crimson Velvet
backgrounds.rule: Resting upon plush royal crimson silk velvet that absorbs stray reflections and accentuates 22K yellow gold brilliance.

backgrounds.label: Warm Travertine
backgrounds.rule: Staged on rough-hewn ivory travertine stone with subtle natural pits and warm earthy textures.

backgrounds.label: Silk Brocade
backgrounds.rule: Draped across handwoven Banarasi silk brocade with subdued gold zari weaves adding subtle regal depth.

backgrounds.label: Dark Charcoal
backgrounds.rule: Mounted against a matte dark charcoal volcanic slate surface for high-contrast dramatic pop.

lighting.label: Soft Studio
lighting.rule: Diffused large softbox overhead key light at 3200K, preserving true-to-tone metal warmth with gentle specular highlights.

lighting.label: Chiaroscuro
lighting.rule: Directional cross-light with pronounced deep shadows, producing dramatic sculptural relief along gemstone facets.

lighting.label: Golden Hour
lighting.rule: Low-angle warm raking sunlight evoking golden hour, making faceted uncut diamonds sparkle with rich golden amber flares.

presets.label: Polki Emerald Choker Preset
presets.rule: Calibrated specially for uncut flat diamonds and green beryl gemstones, balancing silver foil reflectivity with emerald hue saturation.

levels.rule: Subtle brushed metal sheen with controlled highlights.
Balanced commercial gloss with crisp diamond sparkle.
High-specular editorial dazzle with intense faceted reflections.
Neutral cool studio shadows for catalog clarity.
Warm amber shadow falloff characteristic of Indian bridal photography.
Deep rich terracotta shadow tones for dramatic regal staging.
